name: disabled
meaning: set when IDPOLY is missing or has < 2 points, or GLOBALZONE is missing

name: radius
meaning: max Manhattan XZ distance from pos to the polygon points (pre-test)

name: zone
meaning: GLOBALZONE box; its x/z extent is the grid query rectangle

name: guardian
meaning: IDGUARDIAN; gets msg 0x1D on each rustle (the bull in Level 4 and B1)

name: polygon
meaning: IDPOLY record, a Trajectory {u16 count; Vec3s pts[count]} used as a polygon (x/z used)

name: driftParams
meaning: EmitterDriftParams: hSpeed = EmitterDriftParams p[0] = 10 (horizontal drift per second); vSpeed = p[1] = 20 (vertical per second); life = p[2] = 0x800 ticks (0.5 s); spawnInterval = p[3] = 0x333 ticks (0.2 s), passed to Sfx_SpawnBillboard; sizeStart = 40; sizeEnd = 90; sheetIndex = sprite-sheet index 4 (copied to leafFx.sheetIndex)

name: leafFx
meaning: 16-slot leaf-particle emitter with inline storage (0x98..0x1fc): factory 0x4c9890 sets slotPool = +0x24 (0x4c98cd), particles = +0xe4 (0x4c98d8), count 0x10 (0x4c98e7) and calls Emitter_Reset 0x52dbe3 (0x4c98ee) BEFORE the final HeapOfLeaf vtable (0x4c98f6)
